meta.title: RFQ bid: Quantity above the requested quantity

plan.title: RFQ bid rejects quantity above requested

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Configure the event as an RFQ.
Work on the RFQ stage before configuring its template and items.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Create one line item with the requested quantity set to 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor to the RFQ.
Publish the RFQ for vendor bidding.
Verify the RFQ reached a real published event page.
Move to the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session.
Open this event's live RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Fill the required price fields without submitting, leaving the quantity available for the targeted invalid value.
Enter a vendor quantity of 12, exceeding the requested quantity of 10.
Accept the required terms so the submission attempt tests quantity validation rather than an unrelated prerequisite.

args.because: Quantity cannot be greater than the mentioned quantity

steps.note: Attempt to submit the over-quantity quote and require the application to refuse it.

args.text: Quantity cannot be greater than the mentioned quantity
